newsitem.title: USA: Jefferson to buy L&B Financial.
newsitem.headline: Jefferson to buy L&B Financial.

text.p: L&B Financial Inc said on Thursday that Missouri-based Jefferson Savings Bancorp Inc would acquire it in a cash and stock transaction which valued L&B at about $18.50 per share.

The two companies said in a statement that they signed a definitive agreement and plan of merger for Jefferson to buy all of L&B's outstanding stock for equal amounts of cash and Jefferson common stock.
The value could be adjusted for L&B's earnings and dividends until the end of the month before the close.
It was subject to regulatory and shareholder approval and was expected to be completed in the first quarter of 1997.
Jefferson, the holding company of Jefferson Savings and Loan Association F.A. and First Federal Savings Bank of North Texas, had about $1.1 billion in assets at June 30.
L&B owned all the oustanding capital stock of Texas-based Loan and Building State Savings Bank.
